items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: He used to play with him, um, with, uh, Bob Lyons in a little, uh, marching band they had.

ctx.x: Professor Minetta told us about him too. He used to play with him, um, with, uh, Bob Lyons in a little, uh, marching band they had. Yeah. Talked about him. And every time Huey Long would come to town, they'd get out that band. He liked Bob Lyons. And they'd meet him at the station, march him over to the Roosevelt Hotel.
